title: pseudognaphalium ramosissimum
intro: Pseudognaphalium ramosissimum, commonly known as branched cudweed, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. Branched cudweed is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Pseudognaphalium ramosissimum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
